async def act(page):
    import asyncio

    # Scroll to the bottom of the current page to reveal any lazy-loaded pagination
    await page.evaluate("window.scrollTo(0, document.body.scrollHeight)")
    await asyncio.sleep(0.8)

    # Try common accessible containers for a pagination link labelled "6".
    # Guard any .nth() usage with await locator.count() to avoid indexing errors.

    nav = page.get_by_role("navigation")
    if await nav.count() > 0:
        nav_link = nav.get_by_role("link", name="6")
        if await nav_link.count() > 0:
            # clicking a link that navigates away must be the last action
            await nav_link.nth(0).click()
            return

    contentinfo = page.get_by_role("contentinfo")
    if await contentinfo.count() > 0:
        footer_link = contentinfo.get_by_role("link", name="6")
        if await footer_link.count() > 0:
            await footer_link.nth(0).click()
            return

    pag_group = page.get_by_role("group", name="pagination")
    if await pag_group.count() > 0:
        group_link = pag_group.get_by_role("link", name="6")
        if await group_link.count() > 0:
            await group_link.nth(0).click()
            return

    # Generic fallback: any link with visible text "6" or "Page 6"
    generic_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="6")
    if await generic_link.count() > 0:
        await generic_link.nth(0).click()
        return

    page6_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Page 6")
    if await page6_link.count() > 0:
        await page6_link.nth(0).click()
        return

    # Last resort: perform a relative navigation directly to page 6 of the blog feed.
    # This is the final action if no clickable control was found.
    await page.goto("/?paged=6")
